title: The Salty Dog Vacation Rental
meta_description: The Salty Dog is a 4.00 bedroom, 3.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Tucked in the quiet Forest District of WaterColor, property 134 Royal Fern Way, also known as "The Salty Dog", offers the perfect blend of relaxation, style, and family-friendly comfort. This coastal-inspired retreat includes a fenced backyard, spacious porches, a 6-passenger electric cart, and four adult bikes—everything you need for an unforgettable 30A getaway.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 8 Passes Included 6-Passenger Street-Legal Electric Cart Included in Rental 4 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Pet-Friendly (Additional Fee Applies) Fenced-In Backyard Propane Gas Grill Parking for 2 Vehicles Spacious Porches Hardwood Floors Throughout Gas Range 2-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 5-Minute Electric Cart Ride to WaterColor Beach Access 4-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Welcome to The Salty Dog, a charming coastal retreat designed for comfort and connection. With open living spaces, inviting porches, and a fenced backyard, this home perfectly captures the relaxed WaterColor lifestyle. The main level welcomes guests with an airy open floor plan and hardwood floors throughout. The living room offers plenty of comfortable seating for relaxing after a day at the beach, while the adjacent dining area seats six at the main table, four at a smaller kitchen table, and four more at the bar. The fully equipped kitchen features stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, a farmhouse sink, and a gas range—ideal for preparing family meals and coastal favorites. Also on the first floor, the queen guest suite provides privacy and convenience, complete with a private bathroom featuring a walk-in shower and double vanity. A half bath and laundry area complete this level. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite offers a king bed, private bathroom with soaking tub, walk-in shower, and double sinks. Down the hall, two guest bedrooms share a bathroom with a tub/shower combination—one with two twin beds and the other with a twin-over-twin bunk bed, perfect for children or guests. Outdoors, enjoy morning coffee or evening cocktails on the covered porches, or gather with family and friends in the fenced backyard for a barbecue or evening under the stars. With a 6-passenger electric cart and four adult bikes included, exploring Camp WaterColor, Seaside, and the Beach Club is easy and enjoyable. At The Salty Dog, every detail has been designed for comfort, relaxation, and making memories on 30A.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor: Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Second Floor: Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Soaking Tub and Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Guest Bedroom: Twin Bunk Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Life in WaterColor Located in the Forest District, The Salty Dog is perfectly positioned for easy access to both Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club. With peaceful surroundings, spacious living areas, and modern comforts, this home offers a relaxed and luxurious experience in one of 30A’s most beloved communities.
